"title": "Review mortgage document collection needs",
"text": "Review Nolan and Lena Pebblefizz's mortgage file for completeness and planning relevance.\n\nEvidence to collect:\n- Current mortgage statement\n- Promissory note or loan summary, if available\n- Closing disclosure or settlement statement, if available\n- Escrow statement, if applicable\n- Property tax bill or assessment notice, if available\n- Homeowners insurance declaration page, if relevant to cash-flow review\n- Refinance, payoff, or modification correspondence, if applicable\n\nReview criteria:\n- Confirm current balance, interest rate, payment amount, and loan type.\n- Identify fixed versus adjustable rate features and any reset terms.\n- Note maturity date, prepayment penalties, balloon features, or special clauses if shown.\n- Separate principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and other escrow items where possible.\n- Compare mortgage obligations with the cash-flow plan.\n- Flag missing documents or conflicting figures for follow-up.\n\nThey agreed to complete the post‑closing mortgage and insurance file by obtaining the final closing disclosure, the current mortgage statement, and the insurance declaration page.",
